name: projekt-skills
description: Connect a Projekt Republic organization and automate tasks, time, documents and reports through its REST API with your own Personal Access Token — and use Projekt as an AI-context store (memories ↔ documents, Serena-style). Plus `pr-tokens`: measure a session's real token cost from the local transcripts and install the context rules that cut it. Four skills (`pr`, `pr-informes`, `pr-docs`, `pr-tokens`) over a GENERATED catalogue of all 917 operations in 16 domains, any of which can be called through one guarded CLI. Token-efficient, Markdown-native, dry-run by default.
